svg.title: CARE-RFT: confidence-anchored reinforcement finetuning
svg.desc: The reverse-KL penalty keeps growing as a token becomes more likely than under the reference model, while CARE-RFT's skew reverse KL caps it at log(1/alpha) and keeps an unbounded penalty against probability depletion. During reinforcement finetuning, no KL over-sharpens the distribution, reverse KL suppresses the reward-aligned token, and CARE-RFT lets it grow while the rest of the distribution keeps its mass.

g.text: KL penalty on a token vs. how far it moved
CARE-RFT caps it for increases, not decreases
